source.title: [Follow-up] [Bounty #743] Validate /api/users payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

`POST /api/users` forwards `req.body` straight into `createUser` (`apps/api/src/controllers/userController.js`) without any schema validation, and `createUser` spreads the whole payload into the record it persists (`apps/api/src/services/userService.js`). Any JSON object is therefore accepted: missing `email`/`fullName`, malformed e-mail addresses, unhashed `password` values and unknown properties (including `__proto__` style keys) all end up in the user store.

Reproduced on `main` (`apps/api`): a request with `{"email":"not-an-email","fullName":"Ada Lovelace"}`, `{"email":"ada@example.com"}` (no `fullName`), `{"email":"ada@example.com","fullName":"Ada Lovelace","isAdmin":true}` and `{"email":"grace@example.com","fullName":"Grace Hopper","password":"plain-text-secret"}` each answered `201` and persisted the malformed record, including the plain-text password.

## Requested fix

Add a strict Zod schema for user creation and validate the request in `userController` before persistence. Require a valid RFC-compliant email, require `fullName` between 2 and 100 characters, allow an optional `bio` (up to 500 characters) and the standard `role` (`"client"` or `"freelancer"`), keep unhashed passwords out of the persisted record, and reject malformed payloads with a `400 Bad Request` error envelope. Add focused route/service tests for a valid payload, an invalid email, a missing `fullName`, unknown-property rejection and password exclusion.

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty (#743) and the pull request for it will reference this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700

Bounties can only be paid upon successful PR merge.
